5.4.7 DeepNorm
Function Usage
During the training process of a deep neural network, DeepNorm can be used as a
replacement for LayerNorm normalization in order to improve the stability of
Transformers by expanding residual connections.
This API applies DeepNorm normalization to input data with a shape size of [B, S,
H]. The calculation formula is as follows:
DeepNorm(x) = LayerNorm(α * X + SubLayer(X))
SubLayer(X) typically refers to a sub-layer in the DeepNorm model, and is used to
implement the self-attention mechanism. This API will be passed as an input
tensor.

inline __aicore__ uint32_t AlignToBlock(const uint32_t inputValue, const uint32_t typeSize)
{
constexpr uint32_t ONE_BLK_SIZE = 32;
uint32_t alignUnit = ONE_BLK_SIZE / typeSize;
return (inputValue + alignUnit - 1) / alignUnit * alignUnit;
}
